plan: Turn 1: Rillaboom uses Fake Out on the biggest threat while Hydreigon sets Tailwind. Focus Sash keeps Hydreigon alive for one hit.
Grassy Terrain triggers Volcarona's Grassy Seed. Under Tailwind, use Quiver Dance once or twice while a partner takes attention, then sweep with Heat Wave and Bug Buzz.
Mega Metagross removes Fairies and Sneasler. Keep it away from Charizard-Mega-Y and strong Fire or Ground attacks.
Against Trick Room, use Protect on both sides to use up its turns. Volcarona's Quiver Dance boosts still count after Trick Room ends.
cautions: Charizard-Mega-Y OHKOs Metagross, Volcarona and Rillaboom. Only Rotom-Wash OHKOs it, so keep Rotom-Wash healthy.
Nothing OHKOs Kingambit without a boost. Burn it with Will-O-Wisp, or hit it with a boosted Heat Wave.
Volcarona and Sylveon are weak to Poison, and no member resists it. Watch Sneasler's Dire Claw.
Rain halves Heat Wave. Against rain, Volcarona needs more boosts, or it stays in the back.

roles.Metagross: Mega attacker. Psychic Fangs for Fighting types, Iron Head for Fairies, Stomping Tantrum for Fire and Steel.
roles.Hydreigon: Tailwind setter with Focus Sash. Draco Meteor and Dark Pulse for Dragons, Ghosts and Psychics.
roles.Volcarona: Quiver Dance win condition. Grassy Seed gives +1 Def in Grassy Terrain. Heat Wave and Bug Buzz.
roles.Rillaboom: Fake Out, Grassy Glide priority and terrain. High Horsepower for Steel types.
roles.Rotom-Wash: Answer to Charizard-Mega-Y and Fire types. Will-O-Wisp for physical attackers like Kingambit.
roles.Sylveon: Spread Fairy damage with Hyper Voice. Immune to Dragon; Quick Attack finishes weak targets.

archetypes.Sun: Lead Rotom-Wash. Keep Metagross, Volcarona and Rillaboom away from Charizard's Heat Wave.
archetypes.Rain: Rillaboom and Hydreigon take Water well. Volcarona waits until the rain ends.
archetypes.Sand: Grassy Glide and Rotom-Wash's Hydro Pump punish Ground and Rock types. Watch Rock Slide on Volcarona.
archetypes.Snow / Aurora Veil: Break the setter before Aurora Veil goes up: Fake Out it or target it on turn 1. Heat Wave hits Ice types hard.
archetypes.Trick Room: Hit the setter on turn 1. If Trick Room goes up, use Protect to use up its turns.
archetypes.Psychic Terrain: Fake Out and Grassy Glide fail in Psychic Terrain, and Grassy Seed does not trigger. Switch Rillaboom in later.
archetypes.Tailwind offense: Match Tailwind with Hydreigon, and use Protect to use up theirs.
archetypes.Redirection + setup: Spread moves (Heat Wave, Hyper Voice) ignore redirection. Volcarona out-boosts most setup.
archetypes.Fake Out balance: Intimidate does not affect Volcarona, Sylveon, Hydreigon or Rotom-Wash. Lead special attackers.
archetypes.Screens: Pressure Grimmsnarl early. It leaves with Parting Shot, so attack the partner. Quiver Dance through the screens.
archetypes.Mega Flying Tailwind: Rotom-Wash's Thunderbolt and Iron Head from Metagross. Keep Rillaboom and Volcarona away from Flying moves.
archetypes.Raichu offense: Stomping Tantrum from Metagross. Rillaboom and Hydreigon resist Electric.
archetypes.Metagross mirror: Heat Wave from Volcarona and Dark Pulse from Hydreigon beat Metagross. Rotom-Wash burns it.
